$comment: Table stakes per kind of site. A spec picks one with `site_type` and gets these recall items. Placeholder values count as present, so a site with `[Your phone]` still has contact details.

table-stakes: A hero section in the first screen that names the business and says what it does
A navigation menu linking to the main sections
Opening hours
A menu, products, or services section
A contact call to action: a `mailto:` or `tel:` link, or a contact form
Contact details (email or phone) visible as text, not only behind a button
The address, with a map or directions link
A hero section in the first screen that says what the event is, when, and where
A registration or ticket call to action in the first screen
The registration call to action repeated or reachable further down the page (e.g. near the agenda)
An agenda or schedule laid out so it's easy to scan
Venue details with a map or directions link
A navigation menu or in-page anchors to the main sections
A hero or intro that names the person and what they do
A gallery or grid of work
An about section or page
A contact call to action: a `mailto:` link or a contact form
Navigation between the work categories or sections
A hero section that names the band
Music or listen links (streaming platforms or an embedded player)
Upcoming shows or tour dates
An about section
A booking or contact call to action
Social media links
